11XJG10 AP001 = Minato Maru · port main engine · Liquid cooling system (jacket water) 10 · pump unit 001
G F0 FFF NN · AA NNN · BB NN: plant (1 the ship) · identical system (0 common, 1 port main, 2 starboard main, 3 generator No.1, 4 generator No.2) · function key ·
subsystem decade · equipment key and number · component
AA valves: 1xx electric actuator, 2xx pneumatic/hydraulic/solenoid, 4xx drain and vent, 5xx hand, 6xx mechanical (thermostat), 9xx safety. C* measuring: 0xx remote
Symbols after ISO 10628: pump (circle, triangle), M its motor, E engine-driven; valve (bowtie), non-return (dot), QC quick-closing, safety (spring); strainer, filter,
cooler, tank with level, sea chest, OB overboard, deck connection (flange), manifold (bar), hydrant (H).
M/V MINATO MARU みなと丸 · hull No. 127
No electric pump: the circuit lives and dies with its engine. Filled from the
fresh-water system (8.8) through the expansion tank.

in mm (DN). A dashed line is not a pipe (a wire, a can, a cable).
